title: Three embedding lints: framing headers, target=_top, localStorage namespace
description: Three pure assertions callable by any test harness; test/view/wespa-host-fixture.test.js is the suite caller. (1) `assertFramingHeaders(response)` refuses on `X-Frame-Options` or on CSP `frame-ancestors` forbidding same-origin, and accepts `frame-ancestors 'self'`. (2) `assertNoTargetTop(renderedHtml)` greps for `target="_top"` / `target='_top'` / `target=_top` and refuses on any match; returns `{ ok, count }`. (3) `assertLocalStorageNamespace(sourceTreeRoot)` walks every .js file under `src/view/**` (excluding vendored and .min.js) and asserts every `localStorage.*` / `sessionStorage.*` / shared `storage.*` call site uses a key literal starting with `rcf-view:v1:` or a constant resolving to that prefix. Together they pin AC-206-5 against regressions.
